title: Give leads a choice don't chase them
description: Give leads a choice don't chase them
transcript: What we do is once again instead of being like let me put them down this one way funnel I try to avoid one way funnels as much as possible because I've noticed that in the short term they can provide more but in the long term you lose a lot of money so I essentially like to give people optionality so in my new subscriber sequence we say thanks for joining the Scaling Scoop this is the number one uh newsletter for coaches, consultants and agency owners trying to scale to over $100,000 a month check out some of our previous letters and it'll be like how I doubled my show up rate with this one Google sheet and it's just a hyperlinked blog post or YouTube video and then it'll be um you know how to increase your close rate doing this one thing here this the the marketing system we use to book 10 to 15 sales calls every single day and so those are all just going to different YouTube and so they can choose whatever their biggest pain point is at that time which video they wanna watch but of course because it's YouTube they just have to click on one of them and then YouTube's gonna serve them and the nice thing about YouTube Organic is that instead of me trying to guess what they want YouTube's algorithm knows way more about them than I do so because they have clicked on one video That is of me. Then what YouTube will do is essentially look at all of my other videos and say, okay, uh, this guy actually likes Robbie or he's showing some interest in Robbie's contents. Let's go through all Robbie's content to find the piece of content that he would most likely to watch based on his previous watch history and then show him that in the sidebar of other videos.
